title: feat: hooks and record-triggered flows set the save notice (ctx.notice, save_notice node)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

Fixes #28251

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- 钩子（含沙箱化的 shipped body）现在可以调用 `ctx.notice(message)` 设置保存提示，新建/更新的应答里带回 `notice`。
- 记录触发的流程新增 `save_notice` 节点，同样设置这次写入的 `notice`。只有一条通道，就是写入自己的 `onNotice`。
- `save_notice` 只能放在由记录新建/更新触发的流程里，其他地方在发布时就会被响亮拒绝。审批或等待之后恢复的分支、子流程、map 子项在运行时会按名字拒绝。
- 流程提示可翻译，键是 `flows.<flow>.notices.<node_id>.message`，按写入者的语言渲染。`notice` 在线上仍是纯字符串。
- 范围只限单条记录的新建和更新。批量、克隆和流程节点自己的写入都不带提示。
- 钩子这一面的提示要不要也有翻译目录(`hooks.<hook>.notices.<KEY>.message`):席位已裁定 A,暂不做(卡上 `6562118323`),等第一个需要本地化提示的钩子再立卡。不需要你拍板。

## What changes

**Hook face: `ctx.notice(message)`.** `HookContextSchema` gains an optional `notice` member (`HookNoticeSetter`). ObjectQL's `triggerHooks` binds it on every `beforeInsert` / `afterInsert` / `beforeUpdate` / `afterUpdate` dispatch (`packages/objectql/src/hook-notice.ts`). Every dispatch site therefore has it, and no site can forget it. A call reads the write's own `onNotice` listener off `ctx.input.options` at call time and hands it the message. A write that passed no listener sets nothing. A message that is not a non-empty string throws a `TypeError` naming the call, so the write fails loudly instead of silently dropping the notice. Delete and read dispatches carry no member. The body runner passes the member through, and the QuickJS runner installs it as a host function, so shipped bodies (and handlers the build lowers into bodies) can call it. It needs no capability.

**Flow face: the `save_notice` node.** `FlowNodeAction` gains `save_notice`, and its config is `SaveNoticeConfigSchema` (`{ message }`, one `{{ }}` text slot). The record-change trigger already runs the flow inside the write that fired it. It now hands the run that write's channel (`AutomationContext.saveNotice`, wrapping `ctx.notice`) and closes the channel when the handler returns. The executor renders the message and sets it.
- At publish, the `FlowSchema` parse refuses the node at any region depth unless the flow's start is a create or update record trigger (`save-notice-placement.ts`). The refusal is `INVALID_METADATA` 422 at `nodes.<i>.type`.
- At run, the node refuses by name when the run holds no channel: a leg restored after an approval or a wait, a direct `execute`, or a subflow or map child (both delete the channel from the child context). It also refuses when the channel is closed, which covers a leg resumed in memory after the write answered.

**Why a node, not a member of an existing node (measured).** The flow that asked for this (HotCRM's deal submission, #27380 row 3) sends the record for approval. Its graph has no record-write node before the `approval` node that suspends the run, so a member on `update_record` would have nowhere to go. A member on `end` would run only after the approval, on a resumed leg, when the write has already answered. A dedicated node is the smallest surface that can stand before the suspension.

**Message form (Wanted 3).** The platform's translatable-message shape is a catalog key that the server renders in the reader's locale (`flows.<flow>.refusals.<node_id>.message`, `hooks.<hook>.refusals.<CODE>.message`). The flow notice uses that shape: `flows.<flow>.notices.<node_id>.message` (`flowNoticeMessageKey`), picked in the writer's locale before the holes are filled. `os i18n extract` scaffolds the key, the coverage gate demands it, and `objectstack validate` refuses a key over an unknown flow or node or a non-`save_notice` node. So the wire `notice` stays a plain string, and no widening of `CreateDataResponseSchema.notice` / `UpdateDataResponseSchema.notice` is needed. A hook-side catalogue is left to a maintainer decision (see the report).

**Other surfaces.**
- The translation liveness row for `flows.notices` is `live`, cited to its reader.
- The lint closed-binder set includes `save_notice`, which binds nothing.
- The showcase demonstrates the node on `showcase_task_completed` (with zh-CN).
- The platform checklist matrix item counts the new variant.
- Spec artifacts were regenerated.

## Why

#28247 added `notice` to the create and update answers, but only an in-process caller passing `onNotice` could set it. Shipped hook bodies and flows had no way in, so HotCRM faked the sentence with a `record:alert` banner.

## Verification

- **Red first through REST (live showcase, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev -- --fresh`).** The probe installed `app.probe1`, saved an object, a hook whose body calls `ctx.notice`, and a `record-after-update` flow with a `save_notice` node, then created and updated a record.
  - Base `4bf48a8c` (spec, objectql, runtime, trigger and automation rebuilt from base): `POST` → 201 with no `notice`; `PATCH` → 200 with no `notice`. A `save_notice` flow under `record-after-delete` was saved, 200.
  - Head: `POST` → 201 `"notice":"Sent Acme for approval"`; `PATCH` → 200 `"notice":"Moved Acme to review"`; the delete-trigger flow → 422 `INVALID_METADATA`, `issues[0].path` `nodes.1.type`.
- **New tests.**
  - `spec/src/automation/save-notice-node.test.ts` (17)
  - `objectql/src/protocol-save-notice-answer.test.ts`, the #28251 block (8 of 22)
  - `runtime/src/sandbox/hook-notice.integration.test.ts`: real ObjectQL, SqlDriver and a QuickJS body
  - `trigger-record-change`: `save-notice-channel.test.ts` (3), plus 2 cases in `record-change-integration.test.ts`
  - `service-automation/src/builtin/save-notice-node.test.ts` (7, real in-memory i18n)
  - `lint/.../validate-translation-references.test.ts` (3)
  - `cli/test/i18n-flow-save-notice-coverage.test.ts` (6)
- **Ablations, all red then restored to the HEAD blob** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). Each one below was broken in turn:
  - the `bindHookNotice` call
  - the member's refusal of a non-string
  - the QuickJS install
  - the body-runner spread
  - the trigger's channel spread
  - the trigger's channel close
  - the subflow delete and the map delete
  - the executor's no-channel refusal
  - the placement refusal
  - the lint collect and orphan check
  - the CLI extract
- **Gates.** `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 116 derived; `--ran` reconciles 115 run and 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, needs every package's dist). `eslint` over the seven touched packages: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- A notice set from a fire-and-forget async `after*` hook that resolves after the write answered is dropped, because the answer has already gone. Await the work, or set the notice in a `before*` hook.
- When several hooks or nodes set a notice on one write, the last one wins, as the #28247 contract says.
- `ctx.notice(42)` in a body fails the write as a hook body fault, the same way any other `TypeError` in a body does.
- The Studio palette (`ui/.../flow-canvas-parts.tsx` `NODE_PALETTE`) does not list `save_notice` yet. The node still saves and runs, and the actions feed carries its descriptor.
- HotCRM can drop its `record:alert` workaround once this lands. That belongs to the hotcrm lane; this PR does not touch hotcrm.
